clips.title: The story
paras: Webwood Spider Silk is gathered from Webwood Lurkers in the woods of Teldrassil. Crafters use spider silk in many ways, but these swatches draw the interest of suspicious figures among the World Tree’s boughs.

Webwood Lurkers around Dolanaar spin a fine, strong thread that is dangerous to gather. Zenn Foulhoof, a satyr along the forest road, asks young adventurers to collect the silk with nightsaber fangs and strigid owl feathers. He says these rare reagents are needed for his forest business, and newcomers gather them without asking about his corrupt nature or true motives.
